name: controle-nc-android
description: Android wrapper for the Controle de Não Conformidades app

scripts.cap:sync: npm run copy:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && android\gradlew.bat -p android assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-release.ps1
